submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole is the GELU-off side of N299: it sits at a ~0.10-0.17 baseline on ordinary non-initial tokens and shuts off to ~0 on the sequence-first token and on the function-word positions where the positive pole fires (infinitival/prepositional 'to', 'into', demonstratives like 'this', possessives like 'your'). It depends only on the current and immediately preceding tokens (mean IG distance ~2 tokens), so it is retrospective, not a next-token predictor (Jacobian kurtosis ~3.1, incoherent promoted list).
